# Weekly note — CLIENT: LADDERWORKS

## Purpose

A fixture client contract whose only job is to declare a strength ladder the
register validator can check: three levels, weakest first, each saying which
universal level it maps to.

## Selection

### Usable

- The signal names a part, a tolerance or a lead time a small shop runs.

## Plan

### claim_strength_ceiling

- observed on one shop floor → universal level 2
- confirmed by the manufacturer → universal level 3
- established across the trade → universal level 4
